# Stratos Games

Stratos Games is an indie game studio and a game portal. Play free casual, puzzle, word and party games in your browser, made by the Stratos family and the studio. Humans test, AI builds, games ship.

## Play (free browser games)
- [Magic Shot](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza/): A magical liquid-sorting puzzle: pour glowing potions between enchanted bottles until every bottle holds one colour. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Ashgrove Extraction](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-ashgrove-extraction/): A third-person survival shooter: find Mara in a militia-held town, keep her alive, call for help and reach the evac helicopter. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Arrow Rush](https://stratos.games/play/mody-sahariar1/): Clear every arrow off the board without a collision. 100 classic levels and 10 adventure worlds. Made by Sahariar Mody.
- [Mystery Island](https://stratos.games/play/nikhatenglish89/): Explore five islands, solve puzzles and mini-games, and collect the map pieces that unlock the treasure. Made by Nikhat.
- [Fight for Right](https://stratos.games/play/saiqulmodi/): Fly a stealth jet through the sky while launchers on the ground fire ever-smarter homing missiles at you. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Bridge Genius: Setu Builders](https://stratos.games/play/saiqulmodi-bridge-genius/): Build real-physics bridges, railways and signals across India, and earn your building money by learning. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Domino Wonder Dash](https://stratos.games/play/saiqulmodi-domino-wonder-dash/): Trace real outlines, topple the dominoes and learn 366 things: ABC, Hindi letters, numbers, animals, maps and more. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Survival](https://stratos.games/play/saiqulmodi-squirrel-vs-viper/): Mongoose vs viper in the jungle: leap and bite the snakes crawling out of their holes, or play the viper and strike with your head. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Skyfall Armada](https://stratos.games/play/shoaibul0926/): Command a flying warship, destroy enemy fleets, and rule the skies in fast-paced aerial battles. Made by Shoaibul Hoque.
- [Echo Island](https://stratos.games/play/sksarfarajali/): Explore a living island, bond with creatures and rebuild its lost memory, where every choice changes the world. Made by Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Island Match Quest](https://stratos.games/play/sumaiyahsultana821-sys/): Flip shells, fruits, and gems to match pairs, clear three islands, and chase a high score. Made by Sumaiyah Sultana.
- [Racing Mania](https://stratos.games/play/Mdsadee527/): Dodge oncoming traffic across three lanes and rack up distance before you crash. Made by Mohammad Sadee.

## Coming soon (claimed by family makers)
- COPROB by Sahid Modi: Plan sneaky routes past cops and guards to pull off colorful, Brawl-Stars-style heists in each puzzle level.

## Studio titles
- [BLOXPLODE](https://stratos.games/games-bloxplode/): Combo block puzzle. Clear lines, chain combos, survive the 10-level Adventure.
- [Arrow Puzzle](https://stratos.games/games-arrow-puzzle/): Every arrow points somewhere. Clear the board without a collision.
- [House Mafia](https://stratos.games/games-house-mafia/): Mafia and Werewolf, set at a house party. 4 to 8 players, 3 to 5 minute rounds.
- [Word Quest](https://stratos.games/games-word-quest/): Drag across the grid, find the words, win the minute.
